propositions: Three near-duplicate detached-child spawn implementations exist at push.py, enrich_drain.py, and compact_trigger.py that independently repeat PYTHONPATH bootstrap, platform detach flags, stdio discipline, and cwd handling

A missing cwd parameter bug at all three sites propagated via deliberate copy-paste across separate tickets, demonstrating that future property changes will similarly replicate across unmaintained duplicates
A single consolidat ed spawn_detached helper in _proc.py must own the PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, and durable cwd logic while remaining stdlib-only and re-raising on failure

Per-caller exception handling and environment construction must remain at call sites since they differ materially (push.py's secret-stripping vs drain/sweep's broad env copying; push.py catches OSError vs drain/sweep catch Exception)
A static test must enforce that detached-spawn signature tokens appear only in _proc.py to prevent fourth and subsequent copy-paste sites from emerging undetected
The cwd fallback in _config_sources.repo_root must accept its raising posture since detached children now have explicit cwd anchoring and long-lived in-process work must handle failures explicitly
